_meta.description: T3 — IB-aangifte (income tax return) assembly for ZZP. Declares 8 P-formulier entities (IBAangifte header + IBWinstOpgave/IBOndernemersaftrek/IBHeffingskortingenAlgemeen/IBLijfrenteAOV/IBBijtellingAuto/IBBox3Vermogen/IBAuditTrail) plus the IBTaxParameterYear metadata entity that holds annually-versioned tariffs/franchises so deployments never need a code change. Per ADR-031 all fiscal logic is declarative metadata (x-openregister-lifecycle / -aggregations / -calculations); the only PHP seam is the existing UrencriteriumGuard reused for the 1225-hour gate. Distinct from the lightweight IbAangifteExport export schema (REQ-ZZP-007).

IBAangifte.title: IB-aangifte
IBAangifte.description: Annual income tax return (P-formulier) for an IB-ondernemer (ZZP/eenmanszaak). Header entity holding status, filing channel, fiscal year and the computed P-formulier totals; child detail lives in the IBWinst/Ondernemersaftrek/Heffingskortingen/Lijfrente/Bijtelling/Box3 entities and is herleidbaar via IBAuditTrail (REQ-IB-001, REQ-IB-009).

bsn.description: Burgerservicenummer of the ondernemer. Special-category identifier — masked in UI lists and never logged raw (ADR-005).
bsn.title: BSN

aangifteType.description: Form type; auto-detected from profiel attributes (REQ-IB-012 routing).
aangifteType.title: Aangifte Type

fiscalistBeconNummer.description: Beconnummer of the filing fiscal intermediary, if Becon-route (REQ-IB-008).
fiscalistBeconNummer.title: Fiscalist Becon Nummer

fiscalePartner.description: Fiscal partner reference + allocation key for partner-verdeling optimisation (REQ-IB-010).
fiscalePartner.title: Fiscale Partner

vorigeAangifteId.description: FK to the superseded IBAangifte for a correctieaangifte (REQ-IB-012).
vorigeAangifteId.title: Vorige Aangifte ID

belastbareWinst.description: Taxable profit after deductions and MKB exemption (MonetaryAmount EUR).
belastbareWinst.title: Belastbare Winst

teBetalenOfTeOntvangen.description: Final payment (positive) or refund (negative) delta (MonetaryAmount EUR).
teBetalenOfTeOntvangen.title: Te Betalen Of Te Ontvangen

digipoortOntvangstBevestigingId.description: Acknowledgement ID returned by Digipoort on successful submission.
digipoortOntvangstBevestigingId.title: Digipoort Ontvangst Bevestiging ID

xbrlInstanceId.description: FK to the stored XBRL document (openregister file, 7-year retention).
xbrlInstanceId.title: XBRL Instance ID

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration; scopes all reads/writes (ADR-005 tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

retention.description: IB returns + supporting snapshots retained 7 years per AWR art. 52.

CONCEPT.label: Concept
CONCEPT.description: Pre-fill assembled from GL; not yet validated.

GEVALIDEERD.label: Gevalideerd
GEVALIDEERD.description: Passed business validation; ready for XBRL generation.

GEVALIDEERD_MET_WAARSCHUWING.label: Gevalideerd met waarschuwing
GEVALIDEERD_MET_WAARSCHUWING.description: Validated but a blocking warning is present (e.g. urencriterium niet behaald, REQ-IB-002).

GEVALIDEERD_DOOR_FISCALIST.label: Gevalideerd door fiscalist
GEVALIDEERD_DOOR_FISCALIST.description: A Becon-route fiscalist approved the return (REQ-IB-008).

XBRL_GEVALIDEERD.label: XBRL gevalideerd
XBRL_GEVALIDEERD.description: XBRL instance generated and validated against NT17 (REQ-IB-007).

XBRL_VALIDATIE_FOUT.label: XBRL-validatiefout
XBRL_VALIDATIE_FOUT.description: XBRL failed NT17 schema validation; indienen blocked.

INGEDIEND.label: Ingediend
INGEDIEND.description: Submitted via Digipoort; audit trail frozen, GL-changes require a correctieaangifte (REQ-IB-009).

CORRECTIE_SUPPLETIE.label: Correctie/suppletie
CORRECTIE_SUPPLETIE.description: A supplementary return superseding a prior filing (REQ-IB-012).

valideren-met-waarschuwing.label: Valideren met waarschuwing
valideren-met-waarschuwing.description: Validation succeeded but the urencriterium or another non-fatal gate raised a warning (REQ-IB-002).

genereer-xbrl.label: Genereer XBRL
genereer-xbrl.description: Serialise to NT17 XBRL and validate (REQ-IB-007).

indienen.label: Indienen via Digipoort
indienen.description: Submit the signed XBRL; freezes the audit trail (REQ-IB-008/009).

correctie-starten.label: Correctieaangifte starten
correctie-starten.description: Begin a suppletie superseding this filing (REQ-IB-012).

IBWinstOpgave.title: IB-winstopgave
IBWinstOpgave.description: Fiscal profit & loss for the return, derived from the commercial P&L with art. 3.6–3.79a corrections (representatiebeperking, niet-aftrekbare boetes, auto-bijtelling). Every line is GL-sourced and links to journaalposten via IBAuditTrail (REQ-IB-001).

omzetExclusiefBtw.description: Revenue excl. VAT, aggregated from GL revenue accounts (MonetaryAmount EUR).
omzetExclusiefBtw.title: Omzet Exclusief BTW

bijtellingPrive.title: Bijtelling Prive
bijtellingPrive.description: The numeric value for bijtelling prive.

representatieCorrectie.description: Representation-cost cap correction per art. 3.15 (MonetaryAmount EUR).
representatieCorrectie.title: Representatie Correctie

fiscaleAfwijkingenLog.description: Discrete fiscal adjustment records with grondslag (REQ-IB-001, design D3). GL is never altered — adjustments are logged here.

post.description: Adjustment type, e.g. REPRESENTATIE_DREMPEL, GOODWILL_AFSCHRIJVING, AUTOKOSTEN_BIJTELLING.
post.title: Post

gebruiker.description: 'system' for auto-detect or a user id for manual override.
gebruiker.title: Gebruiker

fiscaleAfwijkingenLog.title: Fiscale Afwijkingen Log

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (ADR-005 tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

omzetExclusiefBtw.description: Revenue excl. VAT summed over GL revenue postings for the fiscal year (REQ-IB-001). The matched journaalposten are linked into IBAuditTrail.

kostprijsOmzet.description: Cost of goods sold summed over GL cost-of-sales postings (REQ-IB-001).

representatieCorrectie.description: Representatiebeperking per art. 3.15 Wet IB: cap representation costs at 5% of profit; the excess is logged as a fiscaleAfwijking. Expressed declaratively; the cross-record cap is computed by the IbFiscalAdjustmentGuard seam (ADR-031 exception).

IBOndernemersaftrek.title: IB-ondernemersaftrek
IBOndernemersaftrek.description: Self-employed deductions: zelfstandigenaftrek (gated on the 1225-urencriterium, REQ-IB-002), startersaftrek, MKB-winstvrijstelling (REQ-IB-003) and investeringsaftrek KIA/EIA/MIA/VAMIL pulled from bookkeeping-investeringsaftrek (REQ-IB-004).

urencriterium.description: Urencriterium evidence (REQ-IB-002). Qualifying hours computed by UrencriteriumGuard.
urencriterium.title: Urencriterium

zelfstandigenaftrek.description: Self-employed deduction; toegestaan only if urencriterium.behaald (REQ-IB-002).
zelfstandigenaftrek.title: Zelfstandigenaftrek

startersaftrek.description: Starter's deduction, max 3× in first 5 years (art. 3.78).

jaarVanGebruik.title: Jaar Van Gebruik
jaarVanGebruik.description: The numeric value for jaar van gebruik.

maxKeer.title: Max Keer
maxKeer.description: The numeric value for max keer.

startersaftrek.title: Startersaftrek

investeringsaftrek.description: KIA/EIA/MIA/VAMIL pulled from bookkeeping-investeringsaftrek with evidence refs (REQ-IB-004).
investeringsaftrek.title: Investeringsaftrek

mkbWinstvrijstelling.description: MKB-winstvrijstelling = winst na ondernemersaftrek × rate (REQ-IB-003) (MonetaryAmount EUR).
mkbWinstvrijstelling.title: Mkb Winstvrijstelling

totaalAftrek.description: Sum of all allowed deductions (MonetaryAmount EUR).
totaalAftrek.title: Totaal Aftrek

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (ADR-005 tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

urencriterium.description: Qualifying YTD hours for the 1225-urencriterium; excluded categories (sick/leave/vacation/non-billable-admin) do not count per Wet IB art. 3.6 (REQ-IB-002). Reuses the existing ADR-031 guard seam.

mkbWinstvrijstelling.description: MKB-winstvrijstelling rate is read from IBTaxParameterYear.mkbExemptionRate for the belastingjaar; no rate is hard-coded (REQ-IB-003, design D5). Not applied when winst < 0.

IBHeffingskortingenAlgemeen.title: IB-heffingskortingen
IBHeffingskortingenAlgemeen.description: Tax credits: algemene heffingskorting (income-dependent phase-out), arbeidskorting, IACK (single parent + child <12 + working partner), ouderen- and jonggehandicaptenkorting. All tariffs read from IBTaxParameterYear (REQ-IB-006).

inkomenBox1.title: Inkomen Box1
inkomenBox1.description: The numeric value for inkomen box1.

ahkAfbouwToegepast.title: Ahk Afbouw Toegepast
ahkAfbouwToegepast.description: The numeric value for ahk afbouw toegepast.

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (ADR-005 tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

algemeneHeffingskorting.description: AHK = max(ahkMax − ahkPhaseoutRate × (box1Inkomen − ahkPhaseoutThreshold), 0). All parameters from IBTaxParameterYear (REQ-IB-006).

IBLijfrenteAOV.title: IB-lijfrente & AOV
IBLijfrenteAOV.description: Pension-equivalent deductible premiums: jaarruimte + reserveringsruimte per art. 3.127, and fully-deductible AOV premiums. Franchise/rate/cap from IBTaxParameterYear (REQ-IB-005).

jaarruimte.description: Annual lijfrente room for the belastingjaar (REQ-IB-005).
jaarruimte.title: Jaarruimte

reserveringsruimte.description: Cumulative unclaimed room from the prior 10 years, capped per IBTaxParameterYear (REQ-IB-005).
reserveringsruimte.title: Reserveringsruimte

totaalAftrekbaar.description: Sum of benut jaarruimte + benut reserveringsruimte + AOV premies (MonetaryAmount EUR).
totaalAftrekbaar.title: Totaal Aftrekbaar

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (ADR-005 tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

jaarruimte.description: jaarruimte = lijfrenteRate × (min(winst_na_MKB, premiegrondslagMax) − lijfrenteFranchise); all parameters from IBTaxParameterYear (REQ-IB-005, design D6). System computes the default; the accountant may override with grondslag.

IBBijtellingAuto.title: IB-bijtelling auto
IBBijtellingAuto.description: Per-vehicle private-use bijtelling per art. 3.20 (22% regulier; EV-tiered staffel). The netto bijtelling is added back to the fiscal profit as an onttrekking (REQ-IB-013).

datumEersteRegistratie.description: Date of first registration (drives staffel eligibility).
datumEersteRegistratie.title: Datum Eerste Registratie

bijtellingsCategorie.title: Bijtellings Categorie
bijtellingsCategorie.description: The date and time for bijtellings categorie.

priveKilometers.title: Prive Kilometers
priveKilometers.description: The numeric value for prive kilometers.

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (ADR-005 tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

bijtellingBedrag.description: Regulier: cataloguswaarde × evBijtellingStaffel2Pct. EV: evBijtellingStaffel1Pct on first evBijtellingStaffel1Cap, evBijtellingStaffel2Pct on the excess. Staffel parameters from IBTaxParameterYear (REQ-IB-013).

IBBox3Vermogen.title: IB-box 3 vermogen
IBBox3Vermogen.description: Box-3 savings & investments per overbruggingswet (three categories: bank/spaartegoeden, overige bezittingen, schulden). Computes both forfait and werkelijk rendement and selects the lower (REQ-IB-015).

peildatum.description: Reference date (typically 1 January of the fiscal year).
peildatum.title: Peildatum

werkelijkRendementOpgevoerd.description: True if the taxpayer chose to report actual rendement.
werkelijkRendementOpgevoerd.title: Werkelijk Rendement Opgevoerd

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (ADR-005 tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

belastbareGrondslag.description: belastbareGrondslag = max(totaalRendementsgrondslag − box3HeffingvrijVermogen, 0). System computes both forfait and werkelijk rendement and selects the lower for the taxpayer (REQ-IB-015, design D8).

IBAuditTrail.title: IB-audittrail
IBAuditTrail.description: Full herleidbaarheid: every P-formulier rubriek links to its source GL journaalposten or external evidence. Frozen on INGEDIEND; retained 7 years per AWR art. 52 (REQ-IB-009).

regels.description: Audit-trail rows linking each rubriek to its source (REQ-IB-009).

bron.description: GL account range, external API id, or brontabel.
bron.title: Bron

journaalposten.description: Underlying GL entry ids that sum to the value.
journaalposten.title: Journaalposten

regels.title: Regels

totalRegels.description: Count of regels for the audit summary.
totalRegels.title: Total Regels

freezeMoment.description: Timestamp the trail was frozen on filing.
freezeMoment.title: Freeze Moment

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (ADR-005 tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

retention.description: Audit trail retained 7 years per AWR art. 52.

IBTaxParameterYear.title: IB-tariefparameters per jaar
IBTaxParameterYear.description: Metadata entity holding the annually-versioned IB tariffs, franchises, rates and staffels (zelfstandigenaftrek, MKB rate, AHK/arbeidskorting/IACK, lijfrente, box-3 heffingvrij, EV-bijtelling). Decentralising these into config means annual Belastingplan updates need no code change (design D5, risk table).

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year the parameters apply to.
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

evBijtellingStaffel2Pct.description: EV bijtelling tier-2 / regulier percentage, e.g. 0.22.
evBijtellingStaffel2Pct.title: Ev Bijtelling Staffel2Pct
